title: Santa Barbara Bowl

services.name: Kids at the Bowl
services.desc: Please arrive early! The Santa Barbara Bowl has a single point of entry, and entry lines can move slowly-especially close to showtime. Bike Valet (Free!) Ride your bike and take advantage of the FREE Bike Valet provided by Move Santa Barbara. It’s conveniently located near the main entrance. Drop-Offs All drop-offs-including taxi, Uber, Lyft, and personal vehicles-must use the drop-off zone on Milpas Street in front of the Bowl. ➡️ Please travel northbound on Milpas to access the drop-off area. Pick-Ups After the Show Once streets are closed, all pick-ups should be made at the Santa Barbara High School entrance on Anapamu Street. The cab line will be located on Milpas at
